title: T5577 RFID Cards
description: T5577 rewritable RFID cards for 125 kHz access control projects, compatible with configurable LF credential formats and custom encoding workflows.
summary: T5577 cards are rewritable 125 kHz credentials that suit access-control projects needing configurable LF card formats, custom encoding and migration-friendly deployment.
Chip Compatibility: The T5577 card is compatible with the Atmel T5557/ATA5567 chips and can replace the Atmel e5551/T5551 in most common operation modes.
Rewritable Data: Unlike traditional read-only cards, the T5577 allows you to rewrite data on the card.

faq.question: What are T5577 RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for low-frequency projects that need rewritable cards, configurable credential formats, and custom encoding for legacy reader compatibility.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for T5577 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: ATA5577 Protocol: ISO18000-2 Frequency: 125 kHz Read Range: 2-10cm depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for T5577 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, PET, PETG, ABS Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or Custom Color: Customizable

faq.question: How can T5577 RFID Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Silk-screen printing, CMYK full color, Pantone, digital printing, etc.
